verification.productionCallerInventory: Actual fc5 Swift production source has only APIManager.sendStreamRequest invoking this Coordinator beginRun. R2 replaces that call with the reserved entry; no downstream production same-run legacy beginRun was found. Legacy direct calls in original tests remain.

findings.evidence: A global opaque RunAdmission is reserved before the new suspension. The reserved begin rejects a superseded token before cancelling another producer or replacing its recorder. Original async/sync begin entries reserve anew; matching Stop cannot revoke a different run's token; an old finish preserves a later reservation.

Coordinator.beginRun(admission:recorder:) checks only isCurrentAdmission before task/recorder mutation, and its return does not test task cancellation. APIManager's preceding Task.checkCancellation is not atomic with a later external task cancellation. A still-current but cancelled task can therefore cancel the previous global producer before the subsequent API check rejects it.
findings.requiredNarrowCorrection: Check Task cancellation in the reserved method before any mutation and after the existing recorder await. Retain original legacy overload semantics and add a controlled pre-entry/during-recorder cancellation regression without sleeps or deadline extensions.

findings.evidence: reserveRunAdmission only changes latestAdmission. A new request C on manager M2 can wait for its own older D while the globally current A on manager M1 still runs. Session.requireActive checks own Task/invalidated/activeRun and Dispatcher checks own Task/context; neither consults Coordinator admission. API's main event loop still sees isCurrentRun(A). New callback token checks do not constitute a Host dispatch gate.
findings.requiredNarrowCorrection: Preserve the original synchronous global producer cancellation request when a noncancelled new reservation is accepted, without clearing the active identity, recorder, retained task, canonical writer or claiming completion. Keep actual drains and the later guarded begin. A controlled held global A / held own D should verify cancellation was requested before the new wait while the actual drain remains pending.
